name: Guangdong Xianglu Tungsten Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Xianglu Tungsten Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, and sale of tungsten products in China and internationally. The company offers tungsten carbide powder, tungsten powders, tungsten trioxide, blue tungsten oxide, cemented carbides, tungsten wires, lanthanum tungsten bars, and lanthanum tungsten rods; and cemented carbide series. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Chaozhou, China.
